name: ntfy
description: Send push notifications to phone/desktop via ntfy.sh or a self-hosted ntfy instance over its HTTP API.

server.title: ntfy server
server.description: URL of the ntfy server to publish to, e.g. https://ntfy.sh or your self-hosted instance.

topic.title: ntfy topic
topic.description: Default topic notifications are sent to. On public ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic name receives its messages, so pick a long random name there.
